brand_identity.positioning: The premier international maritime exhibition connecting European technology with Eurasian shipbuilders, shipowners, and marine engineering powerhouses.
brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Authoritative, engineer-precise, visionary, maritime-rooted. No tech jargon, no empty hype.

theme_sentence_options.en: Where East Meets West on Maritime Waters.

benchmark_insights.smm_hamburg: SMM focuses on global scale and transition ('driving the maritime transition'). Europort Istanbul counters with strategic geographic consolidation and direct B2B shipyard connectivity.
benchmark_insights.posidonia_events: Posidonia excels at shipowner prestige and national pavilions. Europort Istanbul delivers deep technical specialization and the bridge between Dutch maritime engineering and Turkish shipbuilding excellence.

layout_and_architecture.grid_system: MODE A: Tetris Grid with asymmetric editorial tension. 12-column master grid on desktop (col-span-8 dominant visuals, col-span-4 technical feeds, col-span-2 micro metrics).
layout_and_architecture.spacing_scale: Tailwind generous spacing: p-6 to p-12 for cards, py-20 to py-28 for full sections. Strict internal padding to guarantee 0% border text collision.
layout_and_architecture.card_surfaces: 1px crisp solid border (border-[#797AAF]/20 in dark mode, border-slate-200 in light mode) with sharp or subtle rounded-lg geometry (max 8px radius).

motion_and_interaction.principles: Controlled maritime kinetic discipline. Zero playful bouncy easing. Easing formula: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ('expoOut').

components.hero_line_reveal: Masked slide-up reveal with staggered delay for coordinates and headline.
components.editorial_ribbon: Continuous slow drifting ticker (velocity: 25s per cycle) showcasing pavilion nations and leading exhibitors.
components.stat_counters: Dynamic numeric increment with IBM Plex Mono format.
components.theme_toggle: Instantaneous theme transition with CSS custom properties, retaining state in localStorage.

rules: Follow .js and .jsx conventions (React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons + Framer Motion).
Never use generic AI fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk). Headings and body MUST use Nunito; Technical labels and coordinates MUST use IBM Plex Mono.
Strictly preserve brand colors: Europort Navy #07255C, Europort Periwinkle #797AAF, Signal Orange #EA580C, Crisp White #FFFFFF.
No violet/purple/pink neon gradients. Use crisp solid lines, bathymetric vectors, and subtle film grain.
Every interactive element and key text MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Light mode and Dark mode must both be fully supported and toggled smoothly.
All text in the user interface must be in English (per explicit prompt requirement).
